revisions.reason: Include the historical validate_acceptance behavioral suite required by additive chain coverage (E230).
Apply repository Black formatting to the locked behavioral test without changing its contract.
Strengthen the unrelated-option contract after review exposed Playwright --project values as a false E500 path.
Harden Cypress spec parsing after review: validate comma-separated targets, split unrelated option values, and command-relative paths.
Validate every explicit Cypress spec value and attached command-directory containment; bound unrelated split-option guarantees to recognized options.
Clarify the approved parser boundary: direct argv tokens only; nested shell-language command strings remain outside this task.
Reset runner-local cwd across command segments and preserve Windows absolute spec identity before cwd joining.
Preserve legacy acceptance command paths and gate Cypress spec extraction to Cypress and Nx e2e invocations.
Normalize effective commands for Cypress/Nx gating, cover Nx target flags, and reset legacy runner cwd between segments.
Normalize package-runner cwd flags before Cypress detection and restrict Nx e2e activation to target positions and flags.
Recognize configured Nx e2e targets and consume split npx package options before effective executable detection.
Consume npx package injection across standalone flags and explicitly skip shell -c command strings.
Separate glob containment from literal existence and tighten effective shell -c command-string exclusion.
Normalize package exec separators and remove npx value-option arguments before executable detection.
Normalize env/uv execution wrappers before nested npx options and bound wildcard support to Python glob syntax.
Align raw npx option consumption and handle shell -c separators plus env long standalone flags.
Consume npx values in legacy containment and scope cwd options to outer package-runner prefixes.

artifacts.name: validate_acceptance
artifacts.description: Validate existing positional acceptance test paths and every directly tokenized Cypress or Nx e2e --spec assignment value, including lists, nonconventional filenames, split or attached command-relative paths, and cross-segment cwd reset; report E500 against each extracted path while leaving unrelated --spec options untouched and ignoring the bounded recognized set of non-target option values. Nested shell-language command strings are outside this argv parser.

artifacts.name: validate_manifest_paths
artifacts.description: Reject every directly tokenized Cypress or Nx e2e --spec assignment value, including nonconventional names, non-leading list items, Windows absolute paths, and split or attached command-relative paths, that resolves outside project_root; union these targets with all previously covered general acceptance command path sources. Nested shell-language command strings are outside this argv parser.
